title: Living watercolor dioramas
status: Art-direction proposal; no runtime assets replaced
diagnosis: Each level currently receives a similarly stretched horizon.
settlementTransform scales horizontal and vertical dimensions independently, flattening silhouettes.
city-established opacity declines to 0.05 while city-rising overlays the next level, reducing the established scene's clarity during growth.
Sunset filters reduce brightness and saturation and add a full-card wash.
Near-scale activity has insufficient visual prominence relative to empty foreground road bands.
visualRules: Levels must differ in silhouette, spatial organization, palette and signature activity; use the same daylight for comparison.
Keep architecture at natural proportions. Fit authored compositions rather than stretching settlement strips.
Use close, shallow-depth compositions with inhabited foregrounds; keep sky and data lanes subordinate.
Maintain crisp watercolor pigment, clear light-dark separation and local warm/cool contrast across all clock states.
Foreground residents should read at roughly 12-18 CSS pixels high in a 160-200 pixel compact scene; tune through rendered inspection.
Keep recognizable established buildings opaque. Grow authored local construction parcels from measured downloads, then retain completed parcels.
Use colored accents appropriate to each district; no global saturation filter as a substitute for art direction.
Show ordinary daily life across multiple parts of each level and readable work activity wherever construction is ongoing.
runtimeRules: Lifetime measured downloads remain the sole growth and construction progress input; preserve current 20 thresholds.
Current traffic controls data deliveries; ambient residents can remain active without incoming traffic.
Concept-board residents and construction are references for separate imagegen-generated layered assets, not a baked static replacement for runtime motion.
Keep stable actor, parcel and scene identities across polling, sorting, resizing and level changes; retain elapsed animation time.
Honor pause, motion settings and prefers-reduced-motion.
Sky visitors remain rare randomly timed easter eggs with long quiet gaps.
At the final stage, show an inhabited completed world and maintenance rather than manufacturing further growth.
assetPlan: First author near-scale estate, neighborhood and city compositions to establish the visual language.
Generate separate watercolor architecture, nature, residents, crews, machinery and material assets with imagegen.
Define level-specific anchor maps for buildings, construction parcels, paths and delivery arrival points.
Carry recognizable neighborhood fragments into later stages without dissolving whole scenes.
Finish each remaining level with its own composition and visual identity; do not derive 20 variants from one panorama.
acceptance: Compare level 6, 7 and 11 at the same daylight in desktop and compact cards with labels hidden; they should be immediately distinguishable.
Inspect several seconds of actual rendered walking, working, crane and delivery motion across left, middle and right parts of each scene.
Inspect low, middle and near-complete measured growth; localized construction visibly changes while established buildings stay crisp.
Stop incoming traffic and verify construction stops advancing while ambient life continues.
Inspect pause, reduced motion, polling, sort reversal, resize and stage transition for stable actor timelines.
Inspect all 20 levels without labels and compare adjacent silhouettes, landmarks, spatial patterns and local palettes.
